scope: Technology/Computer Science lesson task packages only

audit_method.central_inputs: Requires a non-thin inline central_input object in every generated Technology package.
audit_method.starter_code: CODE_OR_DEBUG activities require JavaScript language, complete parseable starter code, and at least three inline inputs.
audit_method.tool_environment: Requires a browser, paper, hand-trace, or notes-app route and rejects installation/paid-account dependencies.
audit_method.alternatives: Requires an explicitly same-score or identical-credit manual/pseudocode route in every lesson.
audit_method.placeholders: Rejects \b(todo|tbd|tba|placeholder|lorem ipsum|insert (text|code|data|link)|fill in later|teacher will provide|source to be supplied|download the starter|find (a|an|some) (example|dataset|website) online|prepared artifact|provided worked model)\b.
audit_method.privacy_security: Requires no-real-password, no-live-system, fictional-data language and scans for credential-shaped literals.
